Loss report: woodpecker -> tekton
[external] pipeline/woodpecker/trigger/0 trigger.push: Secret pipemaster-github-webhook (create the Secret pipemaster-github-webhook with key token holding the GitHub webhook secret; the github interceptor rejects a webhook that it does not sign)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/build/step/source-checkout step.action: StepAction ref to the tektoncd-catalog git-clone through the git resolver (the ctx-repo and ctx-sha params carry the repository and the commit)
[emulated] pipeline/woodpecker/job/notify job.needs: implied by finally (a finally task runs after every other task, so the needs are not written; the marker holds them)
